_doc: SO CUA MAY SAN BNB. SUA O DAY, KHONG SUA SAN.py. Sua truc tiep tren GitHub web: bam file nay -> bieu tuong but chi -> sua so -> Commit changes. Luot chay sau tu doc.
_luat: File nay CHI chua SO va DANH SACH, KHONG chua logic. Khoa la bi bo qua va in ra phieu. File hong thi may van chay bang so mac dinh trong SAN.py.
